statements.detail: Optional stricter evidence mode: postflight source observation and receipt self-check; not a sandbox.
Optionally snapshot a named value as a separate typed run artifact.
Declare a top-level user function with local copy-value arguments; every reached path must return.
Return a value from g_func, including inside a branch or loop.
Half-open integer range loop; 1,000,000 total loop-body iterations per run.
Connects a for-loop variable to range(...).
Half-open integer bounds used only in for ... in range(...).
Repeat while a Boolean condition is true; subject to the shared loop limit.
Execute a branch when its condition is Boolean true.
Optional if fallback; `else if` tests another Boolean condition.
Evaluate a selector once, then execute the first exact, dimension-aware matching case without fallthrough.
A lazily evaluated switch label. The first exact match wins.
Optional final switch branch if no case matches.
Read-only count of program arguments, including argv(0).
Starts arbitrary native Rust; compiled mode and exact SHA-256 authorization required.

functions.detail: Prompt for one text line; the answer is preserved in interaction evidence. Do not enter secrets.
Read one zero-based text argument. argv(0) is the program path; use -- to pass arguments to goblin++.
Count array elements or Unicode scalar values in text.
Return a new array with one appended item; the original remains unchanged.
Render a quantity, Boolean, or text for labels; arrays are refused and scientific precision is not guaranteed.
Explicitly parse finite, unitless decimal text; invalid or oversized plain integers fail.
Remove surrounding Unicode whitespace from text.
Case-sensitive text substring test.
Replace all non-overlapping text matches; search text cannot be empty.
Split text on a nonempty separator, preserving empty fields.
Join a one-dimensional text array with a separator.
Append an interpolated text line to hashed run stdout.
Append formatted numeric output to hashed run stdout.
Count FITS HDUs; imported input is read-only and hashed in a run.
Read a FITS header card from a zero-based HDU.
Read a one-based FITS image axis index in a zero-based HDU.
Count image pixels in a FITS HDU.
Read a zero-based image pixel from a FITS HDU.
Calculate the mean of supported FITS image pixels.
Count rows in a fixed-width FITS binary table.
Count columns in a fixed-width FITS binary table.
Read one zero-based row from a FITS binary-table column.
Count non-null numeric values in a FITS binary-table column.
Mean of supported non-null numeric FITS column values.
Minimum of supported non-null numeric FITS column values.
Maximum of supported non-null numeric FITS column values.
Scan a half-open numeric FITS selection; returns [selected rows, used rows, weight sum, mean]. Optional weights must be positive.
Write .txt or .md under RUN_DIR/outputs; GO_PARANOID and seal are optional.
Write a bounded CSV under RUN_DIR/outputs; first row is the header.
Write a bounded TSV under RUN_DIR/outputs; first row is the header.
Write a JSON object under RUN_DIR/outputs with unique keys.
Deterministic sampled FITS histogram; SVG or PNG, not a full-population claim.
Deterministic sampled FITS scatter plot; SVG or PNG.
